Name: Fresh-styled portraits for SVE
Author: Mmabc623
Description:
[size=5]This is a set of portraits created in my usual fresh style, compatible with SVE.[/size]

[size=3]This set includes most of the SVE characters, except for a few older ones. (I'm not very good at drawing elderly characters.)[/size]

[u]！！！！！Please note: Unauthorized reprinting, secondary uploading, reselling, and AI-generated usage of this mod are prohibited.！！！！！！[/u]

[b]Thank you to my friend for coding the CP Mode for my portrait mod! I really appreciate it!♥

[u]The CP code of this mod shall not be misappropriated or replaced without permission![/u][/b]

[b][size=4]Updated the CP Mode. It does not need to be placed in the HD Portrait Mod folder. Simply unzip the file and put it directly into the mod folder.
After installation, launch the game and press the P key to switch portraits when conversing with characters. Press the O key to lock the current portrait (press O key again to unlock it).[/size][/b]

Installation Method:
① SVE (and all its corresponding required prerequisite mods) are needed.[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]3753[/url]]
② We need a Portrait mod [[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]999[/url]]
③We need a PortraiturePlus mod [[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]24534[/url]]
④ Download the portrait mod from this page, then unzip it. Drag the folder (not the individual images) into the following directory:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits
⑤After launching the game, press the P key to switch portraits when conversing with characters.


[b][size=4]1.0.1 fix：
[/size][/b]①It fixes the issue where portraits fail to display in the store mode, and also resolves the problem of Martin and Claire's portraits not showing up in Joja and the cinema.
②Fixed the issue where Morris' portrait fails to display properly, and resolved the portrait display problem of the Traveling Cart.
